summary: Get Water! is a mobile game about water scarcity in India and South Asia and its effects on girls' education. It was developed by Montreal-based start-up Decode Global Studio, aiming to be both educational and entertaining and challenging to play. The game launched for iOS on World Water Day, 22 March 2013, and came to Android a year later for World Water Day 2014.
one_line: Get Water! is a mobile game by Decode Global Studio about water scarcity in India and South Asia and its impact on girls' education.
key_facts: Get Water! is a mobile game about water scarcity in India and South Asia.
The game explores the effects of water scarcity on girls' education.
Get Water! is developed by the Montreal-based start-up Decode Global Studio.
The developer's goal was to create an educational game that is also entertaining and challenging to play.
The game was originally released for iOS on 22 March 2013.
The iOS release date coincided with World Water Day.
The game was ported to Android a year after its iOS release.
The Android version was released for World Water Day 2014.
